data.body:
Gerrit review round-1 addressed — change 2383, patchset 3 (Change-Id I163d9635…).

Patchset 1 got Verified +1 but LLM-Review -1 (BLOCKING). All findings remediated in
patchset 2/3 (no --force, no prod mutation, not self-submitted):

- BLOCKING (secret-detection): the gitleaks generic-api-key hit in
  tests/unit/test_check_ssm_secret_state.py was a FALSE POSITIVE on the terraform resource
  NAME "opcert_ed25519_key" adjacent to "rebar_secrets" on one line. Fixed by splitting the
  resource-name tuple across lines so the detector no longer reads the label list as a
  keyword=value secret. Assertion unchanged; re-scan = 0 leaks (no allowlist needed).
- security/iac (:126): `insecure_value` on a SecureString is now a VIOLATION (provider stores
  it to state as PLAINTEXT). New RED test.
- error-handling (:122-141): unquoted `value = var.<x>` / `value = local.<x>` is now a
  VIOLATION (a real secret into state); `random_password.*.result` stays allowed. New RED tests.
- correctness (:89-98): _block_body brace-matching is now HCL-aware (strings, #/// and /* */
  comments, <<EOF heredocs no longer change depth). New RED regression test.
- tests (:138): added the mirror `value_wo_version`-without-`value_wo` test. tests (:103):
  covered by the new var/local RED tests.
- docs: docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md updated from the retired
  `value="CHANGEME" + ignore_changes=[value]` contract to the value_wo/value_wo_version
  write-only contract, cross-linking ADR-0105 + runbook.
- iac (:104, one-time apply): the value_wo_version absent->1 apply, state scrub, and
  crown-jewel rotation remain the deferred PROD operator work in gnarly-sinistrous-groundhog
  (097b-de23-bf12-4c38), documented in infra/runbooks/ssm-secret-write-only.md.

All new tests proven RED against the pre-fix guard (empty findings) and GREEN after.
make lint + terraform validate pass. Left in_progress; operator to Submit once
LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 are both green on patchset 3.
